_meta.what: The owner's edits to the names the global map writes over its cells.
_meta.why: Those names come from res/database/locations.xml, the player's own file: 414 <location x y text> rows the client draws itself; nothing the server sends touches them. So an edit is made where the file is served -- by the player's launcher (launcher/MapLabels.cs, from the rules tools/export_map_labels.py embeds at build) and by bootstrap_http for a local run (server/map_labels.py). The player's file on disk is never changed.
_meta.rule:
Each edit names a cell (x, y) and the text the row there has now ('was', entities decoded: '
', not '<BR>'). hide: true drops that row; text: gives it another. A row that does not match exactly is left alone, so another copy of the client cannot be edited by mistake.
_meta.edit: Add or change an edit, then rebuild the launcher (launcher/build.ps1) and publish it; a local run picks it up on restart.
